cases.name: Read a partial label
cases.prompt: My bottle says 'Valley Red 2019, 13.5% vol, 750 mL'. I don't see a region or bottling date.
expectations: Records 2019 as the labeled wine year while leaving bottling date open.
Does not invent tasting notes or value.

cases.name: Gift direction
cases.prompt: I own two bottles of the same rye. One was a gift to me; I just gave that sealed bottle to a friend.
expectations: Tracks the gifted-in origin and gifted-out event for the same bottle.
Does not label the given bottle as consumed.
Leaves the remaining bottle’s state unchanged if unknown.

cases.name: Wishlist and impression
cases.prompt: I haven't bought the pear brandy. A shop note says 'ripe fruit'. Add it to the wishlist and leave my tasting notes blank.
expectations: Attributes ripe fruit to the shop if included.
Leaves personal tasting notes and rating empty.
Does not count the entry as owned or opened.
